abstract: Integration guidance for the Terra API mobile SDK 2.x, the on-device path for health sources with no web API: Apple Health (HealthKit), Health Connect, and Samsung Health. Covers the build-once client with a token provider, connect and permission requests (categories and, from 2.3.0, individual types), automatic background sync, diagnostics, detecting and upgrading 1.x apps, and per-platform setup for TerraSDK (iOS), terra-android, @tryterra/react-native, and terra_flutter_bridge 2.x.
